title: Choosing a deployment method for a requirement

kcs.statement: To provision identical infrastructure repeatedly across accounts or Regions, choose CloudFormation (or the CDK); to deploy a web application without managing its infrastructure, choose Elastic Beanstalk.

To automate releasing code changes through build, test and deploy stages, choose CodePipeline with CodeBuild and CodeDeploy; CloudFormation provisions infrastructure but does not by itself run a code release workflow.

problem_ideas: Ten one-paragraph scenarios: for each, name the deployment service and the distractor you rejected.
A bank wants every environment reviewed as code before it is created, and rebuilt identically in a second Region: pick and justify.
A hackathon team needs a Python web app online within an hour, with load balancing: pick and justify.
A team already has templates but releases code by copying files over SSH: what is missing, and which services fill the gap?
An engineer must change one tag on one instance: is CloudFormation overkill? What fits?
Spot the wrong answer: 'Use Elastic Beanstalk to provision a VPC, Transit Gateway and Direct Connect from templates.'
